entities.name: Anton Egon, Prince of Fürstenberg-Heiligenberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anton Egon, a member of the Swabian House of Fürstenberg, was Imperial Prince and Princely Landgrave of Fürstenberg-Heiligenberg from 1674 until his death. He also served as governor of the Electorate of Saxony under the Wettin prince-elector Augustus II the Strong.
